protocol: P104 observational funnel + LIRA claim-warrant register
scores_are: current claim-adoption recommendation, NOT truth probabilities

claims.claim: There are 17 map-derived 50ms geometric stopline-center crossing candidates.
claims.warrant: P34 geometry/P35 independent time-join source checks support exactly the candidate count.
claims.rival: 2015 map stripe need not equal 2023 physical paint.
claims.change_to_reassess: Require independent surveyed 2023 line before upgrading to physical ground truth.

claims.claim: At least one prior signal sample is no older than 1s at bracket end for 16/17 candidates.
claims.warrant: Causally eligible sample at or before start of each 50ms bracket.
claims.rival: Sampled code may change between observations.
claims.change_to_reassess: Reassess with exact clock drift and controller event timestamps.

claims.claim: Nearest-time matching can leak future information: 11/17 P35 candidates.
claims.warrant: Compare retrospective nearest timestamp to crossing time.
claims.rival: Future time sample is not necessarily a different signal code.

claims.claim: A physical 2023 signal-head-to-movement mapping is established for 5 eastern candidates.
claims.warrant: Lane-group hypotheses are not official controller head ownership.
claims.rival: Historical daytime map transfer might be correct but is unverified.

claims.claim: Four of five hypothesized eastern candidates follow expected ordered receiver-entry routes.
claims.warrant: Sequential map-cell path support within same tracking source, not independent physical exit.
claims.rival: Mapping and detection from the same map/tracking data create correlated errors.
claims.change_to_reassess: Reassess using independent camera or verified end-of-link detections.

claims.claim: Four route-compatible trajectories prove their final downstream segment exit times.
claims.warrant: Entry to receiver is not terminal departure.
claims.rival: Fragmented track may be caused by capture boundaries, not blockage.
claims.change_to_reassess: Acquire terminal crossing ID and synchronized end-of-link observation.

claims.claim: All 292 observed green-bracket slots have valid classified simultaneous upstream/receiver frames.
evidence: P38 only 114 selected non-crossing frames; 176 none
claims.warrant: Observed screen has missing and ambiguous intervals.
claims.rival: Absence of one tracked center is not absence of traffic.
claims.change_to_reassess: Create synchronized complete occupancy ground truth for denominator.

claims.claim: No concurrently slow upstream and receiver center seen in 114 selected frames proves no blockage.
evidence: P38 4 slow-upstream-only, 0 both in 114 selected frames
claims.warrant: Failure to detect is not a false-negative-bounded ground-truth classification.
claims.rival: Field of view and timing selection are incomplete.
claims.change_to_reassess: Calibrate detection sensitivity and label upstream/downstream occupancy.

claims.claim: The P101 red-onset high-left-share 64/64 left-delay pattern is reproducible within the T2 model.
evidence: P101 64/64 red onset; 128/128 source-locked spatial identity
claims.warrant: Matched P100 cohort, all 256 replay arms clear; same engine.
claims.rival: Vehicle priority and 4-slot geometry may structurally generate pattern.
claims.change_to_reassess: Reassess if physical geometry or independent-engine replication breaks it.

claims.claim: P101 constitutes a fresh independent replication of P100.
evidence: P101 same 64 P100 tapes, explicit P101 prereg
claims.warrant: Nested mechanism analysis does not create new independent sampling units.
claims.rival: Separate tracing adds explanatory resolution, not independent sampling.
claims.change_to_reassess: Use independent engine and distinct held-out locations.

claims.claim: P71 SUMO comparisons directly falsify P100 downstream 30s vs 60s results.
evidence: P102 says P71 compares upstream left green 10s vs 6s
claims.warrant: Treatment, downstream offset and physical geometry differ.
claims.change_to_reassess: Run P100 exact intervention with isomorphic independent simulation.

claims.claim: Geometry-matched independent engine and mapped field exits are needed before real policy claims.
evidence: P102 P71 SUMO rank agreement 2/64 at offset15 under different intervention
claims.warrant: Current evidence does not identify physical policy causal impact.
claims.rival: Independent engine alone would still not establish real intersection benefit.
claims.change_to_reassess: Update after verified geometry parity and field head/end crossing.

claims.claim: P99 identical signed costs after extending a fully-cleared horizon validates physical delay mechanisms.
evidence: P99 768/768 exact signed pair match after t1440→1464
claims.warrant: No remaining vehicles means additional empty ticks add zero occupancy.
claims.rival: It checks horizon bookkeeping, not physical fidelity.
claims.change_to_reassess: Construct active-arrival near-horizon stress with terminal censor rules.

claims.claim: LIRA 0..1 is a present recommendation to retain the scope-limited claim, not a Bayesian probability.
claims.warrant: Scores are explicit editorial research judgments with rival and change trigger.
claims.change_to_reassess: Revise interpretation if original LIRA protocol changes.
